title: Quantitative spectral stability and sharp Fourier estimates for periodic CMV matrices with decaying perturbations
summary: We study half-line CMV matrices whose Verblunsky coefficients are decaying perturbations of periodic sequences. We quantify the stability of fine properties of the absolutely continuous spectral measure under such perturbations. More precisely, we establish Hölder continuity of the perturbed spectral measure and derive sharp time-averaged Fourier estimates governing the associated quantum dynamics.
